description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the sketch to battlemap workflow: develop an owned sketch into a battlemap. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_sketch_to_battlemap with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_sketch_to_battlemap.
